scope: P10 packaged backend music runtime and remaining live acceptance boundary.
implemented: Both production and self-host Dockerfiles install a pinned yt-dlp artifact after verifying its published SHA-256 checksum.
The runtime includes a pinned Deno JavaScript engine and Debian FFmpeg with libopus support.
The self-host image runs as uid 1000 and contains the compiled HiChat server and migrations.
Image builds fail if yt-dlp, Deno, FFmpeg or a real libopus encode probe is unavailable.
The opt-in integration test covers search-source playback, independent encrypted listener decryption, pause/resume, duplicate enqueue, skip, stop and non-silent decoded audio.
